settings.headline: Valves, actuators and pumps, made and tested in our own plants
settings.subtitle: Pellandry Fluid Controls (fictional) designs and builds industrial valves, actuators and pumps in two plants, and repairs them at a third. Family-owned since 1957 (story). The company, its people, products and figures are fictional; this is a Raytha example site.

settings.headline: What we believe about valves
settings.body:
A valve is usually the cheapest part of a system and the most expensive one to replace. So we design for service in line, keep spare parts for twenty years after a series is discontinued, and publish our datasheets and manuals in full, without a login.

Pricing, CAD packages and service bulletins live in the distributor portal and the service desk, where our partners sign in.

— Ilse Pellandry-Varga, president (fictional)
settings.aside: 1 Foundry Row, Brask Ford (fictional). Inside sales (555) 017-4000, 7 am to 6 pm Central.
